description: SAPOS® Hochpräziser Echtzeit Positionierungs-Service - HEPS is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The high-precision real-time positioning service (HEPS) is available to registered users throughout Bavaria via the Internet (Ntrip). It enables real-time positioning in the official ETRS89 system with an accuracy of 1 - 2 cm (location) and 2 - 3 cm (height). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "SAPOS® High-precision real-time positioning service - HEPS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Positionsgenauigkeit, Echtzeit-Positionierung, Trägerphasenmessung, Freistaat Bayern, Satellitenpositionierung, gdiby. The listing shows 2025-04-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
